title: Improved Bounded Agent-Computer Interface

control_plane.zetsu_mutation_note: The repaired read-only repository-agent proof passed without per_user_worktree_quota. The bounded mutating delegation remained deterministically blocked by the stale promotion target (zetsu_agent_apply_target_not_clean); local implementation was used under the documented fallback, and the production control-plane checkout was not modified.

implementation.coordinator_integration: ZetsuAgentCoordinator exposes the typed actions in its bounded model prompt and dispatches them through the same owner/session/worktree/verifier policy; legacy actions remain compatible during shadow evaluation.
implementation.security_boundary: No generic shell or network operation is exposed. Git is limited to fixed read-only state/diff commands; verification executables are allowlisted and path/options are validated; mutation requires the existing apply_patch grant and a required verifier.
implementation.bounded_output: RepoMap token budget, structured result counts, region line/character caps, search match cap, diff byte cap, git status cap and verifier tail/artifact handling are all explicit. No generation limit or chunked append/write primitive was added.

security_and_negative.bandit_note: Bandit returned zero high-severity findings; its manager emitted only warnings from security-comment words such as argv/shell/allowlisted.

comparison.method: The frozen old coordinator and typed ACI repair surfaces were run on identical two-repository fixtures. Both produced the same exact source bytes and one replacement; typed operations additionally returned structured bounded metadata. The full unchanged coordinator/MCP coding and repair regression suite also passed.
comparison.reason: The typed surface improves operation shape and structured evidence, but this deterministic CPU-only fixture did not establish a material production efficiency benefit. Keep the interface in SHADOW until a frozen local-model workload measures a benefit without correctness or security loss.
comparison.chunked_write_reason: Existing v1 traces/tests already use bounded reads, exact edits, bounded creates and durable large-result artifacts; no real truncation or awkward large-file construction evidence justified a new write primitive.

metrics.typed_result_caps: Deterministic configured caps; not claims about model tokenization.

limitations: SHADOW lifecycle is intentional: legacy actions remain accepted and typed ACI has no independently measured local-model efficiency advantage yet.
Repository structural operations rebuild/use the deterministic repository-context service and are advisory; exact file reads remain required for mutation and verification.
The typed ACI is constructed from an already authorized coordinator context; it is not an independent grant or identity service.

The existing Zetsu repository-agent registry remains stale relative to the current v2 checkout; local implementation was used after the deterministic promotion-target failure recorded in prior certifications.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the selected unchanged suite passed under that permission.
The full G0 production certification was not repeated, per the roadmap instruction and prior phase certifications.

rollback_target.description: G5-certified append-only trajectories and derived checkpoints with production/v1 remaining separately immutable.
